SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_RELATEDCUSTOMER_CCD] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer
AS(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,RelatedCustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT 
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS RelatedCustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM   
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

    SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS RelatedCustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
 WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RelatedCustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RelatedCustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.RelatedCustomerId,TGT.RelatedCustomerId) AS RelatedCustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND	SRC.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA;

-----UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
 AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId  
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode  
 AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31';




-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.RelatedCustomer ( 
CustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,RelatedCustomerNote
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.RelatedCustomerId AS RelatedCustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerRelationshipTypeId
,NULL AS RelatedCustomerNote
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerId = SRC.RelatedCustomerId
     AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	  AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomer_DELTA;

END
GO
